title: Junie — Agentic Coding Cheat Sheet
brandSub: Coding Agent · IDE · CLI · Headless CI/CD

rows.label: What it is
rows.value: Delegate engineering work to an AI agent — not just chat

rows.label: Runs in
rows.value: JetBrains IDEs, terminal (junie CLI), headless CI/CD

rows.label: IDE entry
rows.value: AI Chat → select Junie by JetBrains from agent list

rows.label: Plugin install
rows.value: Marketplace search JetBrains Junie (plugin ID 26104)

rows.label: Min IDE ver
rows.value: 2024.3.2+ for IDEA Ultimate/PyCharm Pro/WebStorm/GoLand

rows.label: Agent loop
rows.value: Prompt → Plan → Edits → Commands → Verification → Summary

rows.label: Best for
rows.value: Bounded, executable tasks with clear success criteria

rows.label: Modes (IDE)
rows.value: Code (full agent) · Ask (read-only) · Auto

rows.label: /remote
rows.value: Remote mode — continue the current CLI session in a browser

rows.label: /agents
rows.value: Custom subagents with a tailored prompt & tool restrictions

rows.label: /extensions
rows.value: Install reusable bundles: skills, MCP, subagents & commands

rows.label: /review
rows.value: Local code review agent over your Git diff

rows.label: /worktree
rows.value: Open the Git worktree menu without leaving Junie

rows.label: Hooks
rows.value: Run shell commands automatically at defined session points

rows.label: ACP support
rows.value: Use Junie CLI from any Agent Client Protocol editor or IDE

rows.label: Jira integration
rows.value: Trigger the Junie GitHub Action from Jira issues & comments

rows.label: IDE bridge
rows.value: CLI uses the connected JetBrains IDE's inspections & features

rows.label: Install (Linux/macOS)
rows.value: curl -fsSL https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh | bash

rows.label: Install (Windows)
rows.value: iex (irm 'https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.ps1')

rows.label: Install EAP
rows.value: curl -fsSL https://junie.jetbrains.com/install-eap.sh | bash

rows.label: Verify
rows.value: junie --version

rows.label: Start in project
rows.value: cd /path/to/project && junie

rows.label: Auth: JetBrains
rows.value: Log in with JetBrains Account — uses AI subscription quota

rows.label: Auth: API key
rows.value: Set JUNIE_API_KEY (generate at junie.jetbrains.com/cli)

rows.label: Auth: BYOK
rows.value: Own keys: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, etc.

rows.label: Headless auth
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" "Fix failing tests"

rows.label: /debug
rows.value: Toggle Debug mode — live debugger via connected JetBrains IDE

rows.value: Local code review wizard (git diff against main, last commit, unstaged)

rows.label: /new [prompt]
rows.value: Clear context and start a fresh session

rows.label: /history
rows.value: Browse & resume previous sessions (last 10 stored)

rows.label: /model
rows.value: Select LLM and reasoning effort level

rows.label: /mcp
rows.value: List, add, enable, or disable MCP servers

rows.label: /worktree
rows.value: Switch between Git worktrees without leaving Junie

rows.label: /remote
rows.value: Open running session in browser at junie.jetbrains.com/remote

rows.label: /usage
rows.value: Show token usage & cost breakdown for the session

rows.label: /extensions
rows.value: Browse, install, update, remove CLI extensions

rows.label: Primary file
rows.value: .junie/AGENTS.md — loaded on every task automatically

rows.label: Fallback
rows.value: AGENTS.md in project root if .junie/ file missing

rows.label: Custom path
rows.value: Set in Settings | Tools | Junie | Project Settings

rows.label: config.json (project)
rows.value: <project-root>/.junie/config.json — shared team defaults

rows.label: config.json (user)
rows.value: ~/.junie/config.json — personal machine defaults

rows.label: Extra config
rows.value: junie --config-location /path/to/config.json

rows.label: Key config fields
rows.value: model, provider, brave, time-limit, guidelines-location

rows.label: Precedence
rows.value: CLI flags > user settings.json > project config > user config

rows.label: Default model
rows.value: Dynamically chosen best price-quality ratio (Default)

rows.label: Select model
rows.value: junie --model sonnet or /model in interactive mode

rows.label: Effort level
rows.value: --effort <low|medium|high|xhigh|max> or /effort

rows.label: JUNIE_MODEL
rows.value: Env var equivalent of --model

rows.label: JUNIE_EFFORT
rows.value: Env var equivalent of --effort

rows.label: Aliases
rows.value: sonnet, opus, gpt, gemini-pro, gemini-flash, grok

rows.label: BYOK providers
rows.value: anthropic, openai, google, xai, openrouter

rows.label: Force provider
rows.value: junie --provider anthropic or JUNIE_LLM_PROVIDER

rows.label: Effort tip
rows.value: Higher effort = higher cost; use only when task clearly benefits

rows.label: Config (project)
rows.value: .junie/mcp/mcp.json — commit to share with team

rows.label: Config (user)
rows.value: ~/.junie/mcp/mcp.json — applies across all projects

rows.label: IDE settings path
rows.value: Settings | Tools | Junie | MCP Settings

rows.label: Add via CLI
rows.value: /mcp then Ctrl+A for Installation Assistant

rows.label: Max tools
rows.value: 100 tools total across all configured MCP servers

rows.label: Approval
rows.value: MCP tool calls require user approval unless on Action Allowlist

rows.label: OAuth MCP
rows.value: Select server → Authorize in /mcp screen

rows.label: Extra locations
rows.value: junie --mcp-location <path> to add custom search folders

rows.label: Core principle
rows.value: Delegate work you want executed, not just discussed

rows.label: Good task
rows.value: Bounded scope, clear input & acceptance criteria, verifiable output

rows.label: Attach context
rows.value: Use @ to attach files/folders; drag & drop images into terminal

rows.label: Follow-up
rows.value: Type follow-up prompts while agent is running — appended immediately

rows.label: Plan first
rows.value: For complex tasks: /plan <prompt> before any edits

rows.label: Review changes
rows.value: Done panel lists all changed files; accept or revert per-file

rows.label: Rollback
rows.value: Decline all changes in the Done panel to roll everything back

rows.label: History search
rows.value: Ctrl+R to search prompt history across all sessions

rows.label: Brave mode
rows.value: /brave or Ctrl+B to cycle: Off → Auto → On

rows.label: Brave Off
rows.value: Ask for approval on every sensitive action (safest)

rows.label: Brave Auto
rows.value: Auto-approve safe commands; ask for risky ones

rows.label: Brave On
rows.value: Execute all sensitive actions without approval

rows.label: Allowlist
rows.value: Click → Always allow on any approval prompt to persist it

rows.label: Allowlist file
rows.value: ~/.junie/allowlist.json — edit manually if needed

rows.label: .aiignore
rows.value: Create .aiignore (gitignore syntax) to protect files from agent

rows.label: Shell passthrough
rows.value: Prefix with ! to run shell commands: !ls -la

rows.label: Diff viewer
rows.value: Click file links in agent output to open diff in IDE viewer

rows.label: Selective revert
rows.value: Accept or reject changes file-by-file in the Done panel

rows.label: /review wizard
rows.value: From Main · Last Commit · Unstaged Changes

rows.label: Custom review
rows.value: /review focusing on performance and memory leaks

rows.label: Headless review
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" --review

rows.label: CRITICAL label
rows.value: Security/crash/data-loss findings prefixed [CRITICAL]

rows.label: Code suggestions
rows.value: Ready-to-apply patches included for safe, simple fixes

rows.label: Human in loop
rows.value: Keep humans in the PR/MR approval path for production changes

rows.value: curl -fsSL https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh | bash

rows.label: Run task
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" "Your prompt here"

rows.value: junie --model sonnet --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" "task"

rows.label: Extra config
rows.value: JUNIE_CONFIG_LOCATION env var for additional config files

rows.label: Disable defaults
rows.value: JUNIE_CONFIG_DEFAULT_LOCATIONS=false for locked-down CI

rows.label: All options
rows.value: junie --help for full CLI reference & env vars
